name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_audience: Small and marginal farmer families who own cultivable land
brief: Income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly transferred to bank accounts.
benefits: ₹6,000 annual direct benefit transfer (DBT)
Paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months
100% funded by the Central Government
Direct bank transfer via Aadhaar-linked accounts

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Must own cultivable land in family name. Institutional landholders and income-tax payers are excluded.

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority (NHA)
target_audience: Bottom 40% vulnerable and poor families identified by SECC 2011 & NFSA
brief: World's largest health assurance scheme providing health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
Covers over 1,949 medical procedures and surgeries
No restriction on family size, age, or gender
Covers pre-existing conditions from day one at empanelled public and private hospitals across India

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Families listed in SECC 2011 deprivation criteria (D1 to D7) or having active Ration Card under NFSA.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY - Housing for All)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
target_audience: Homeless families or those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural and urban areas
brief: Financial assistance to construct or purchase a pucca permanent house with basic amenities like water, sanitation, and electricity.
benefits: ₹1,20,000 to ₹1,30,000 direct subsidy in rural areas (PMAY-G)
Interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh under Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) in urban areas (PMAY-U)
Additional assistance for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission (₹12,000)
Piped water and electricity connection support

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Female ownership or co-ownership preferred.

documents_required: Proof of no existing pucca house / Land document

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
target_audience: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro-enterprises and entrepreneurs
brief: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 lakh for income-generating micro-enterprises in manufacturing, services, and trading.
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to ₹50,000 for starting new micro-units
Kishore: Loans from ₹50,001 up to ₹5,00,000 for expanding units
Tarun: Loans from ₹5,00,001 up to ₹10,00,000 (extended up to ₹20 lakh in 2024)
No collateral or third-party guarantee required
Low processing fees and reasonable interest rates from commercial banks, RRBs, MFIs

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Applicant must have a viable business idea/existing unit and good credit history (no bank loan default).

documents_required: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
Business registration / Trade license / Udyam Registration

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Beti Bachao Beti Padhao initiative
target_audience: Parents or legal guardians of girl children aged 10 years or younger
brief: A government-backed high-interest small deposit savings scheme dedicated to securing the higher education and marriage expenses of girl children.
benefits: High government-guaranteed interest rate (currently ~8.2% compounded annually)
Full tax exemption under Section 80C on investment, interest earned, and maturity proceeds (EEE status)
Minimum deposit of just ₹250 per year; maximum ₹1,50,000 per fiscal year
Partial withdrawal allowed after the girl turns 18 for higher education

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Account can only be opened for a girl child before she attains 10 years of age. Maximum two girl children per family (exceptions for twins/triplets).

documents_required: Birth Certificate of the girl child

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
target_audience: Adult women belonging to BPL (Below Poverty Line) households
brief: Provides free LPG gas connections to adult women from economically backward households to ensure smokeless, healthy kitchens.
benefits: Free LPG connection with deposit-free cylinder and pressure regulator
First refill and LPG stove provided completely free of cost
Direct targeted subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills per year
Protects women and children from toxic indoor air pollution caused by firewood and cow dung

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Applicant must be an adult woman from a poor household. No other LPG connection should exist in the same household.

documents_required: Aadhaar Card of applicant and all adult family members
Ration Card proving family composition / BPL proof
Bank Account Number with IFSC code

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
target_audience: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 working in the unorganized sector
brief: Guaranteed monthly pension scheme for unorganized sector workers starting after attaining 60 years of age.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 after age 60
Same pension amount continues to the spouse upon the subscriber's demise
Entire accumulated pension corpus returned to nominee upon death of both subscriber and spouse
Very low monthly contribution starting as low as ₹42 per month

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Must join between ages 18 and 40. From October 2022, income-tax payers are not eligible to open new APY accounts.

documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Savings Account with auto-debit facility

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
target_audience: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in 18 specified trades
brief: End-to-end holistic support including recognition, skill training, toolkit incentive, and collateral-free enterprise credit at concessional 5% interest.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID card
Basic skill training (5-7 days) & Advanced training (15+ days) with ₹500/day stipend
Toolkit incentive of ₹15,000 e-voucher for modern equipment
Collateral-free enterprise development credit: 1st tranche up to ₹1,00,000 (18 months) and 2nd tranche up to ₹2,00,000 (30 months) at only 5% interest rate
Incentive for digital transactions

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Must be engaged in one of the 18 recognized traditional trades. Limited to one member per family. No government employee in family.

documents_required: Ration Card / Proof of trade activity

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Central Sector Schemes
ministry: Ministry of Education / Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Minority Affairs
target_audience: Meritorious students from economically weaker sections, SC, ST, OBC, and minority communities
brief: Single-window online platform offering pre-matric, post-matric, and higher education scholarships directly into student bank accounts.
benefits: Financial assistance from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000+ per year covering tuition fees and maintenance allowance
Disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) with zero middlemen
Covers school, college, professional graduation (engineering, medical), and post-graduate studies
Merit-cum-means and category-specific scholarships available

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Must be enrolled in a recognized school/college/university. Minimum 50% to 60% marks in previous final examination.

documents_required: Family Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Current college/school Bonafide Student Certificate and Fee receipt

name: PM SVANidhi (PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_audience: Urban and peri-urban street vendors and hawkers
brief: Micro-credit facility offering collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors to revive or expand their livelihoods.
benefits: 1st Tranche: Working capital loan up to ₹10,000 (1 year tenure)
2nd Tranche: Enhanced loan up to ₹20,000 on timely repayment of 1st loan
3rd Tranche: Enhanced loan up to ₹50,000 on timely repayment of 2nd loan
7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account on timely or early repayment
Cashback incentives up to ₹1,200 per year for conducting digital transactions

eligibility_rules.special_conditions: Must possess Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULB) or recommendation letter.

documents_required: Vending Certificate or ID Card from Municipal Corporation / Town Vending Committee
